items.title: Black Tomato Founders Sell 75% to Employee Ownership Trust — But Keep Control: Exclusive
items.summary: The founders of Black Tomato have sold the majority of their shares in a deal that gives them liquidity while keeping decision-making power — and qualifies them for a potential tax benefit.

items.title: F1 Confirms Abu Dhabi Grand Prix — Events Calendar Is Propping Up Tourism

items.title: What Radisson’s Saudi Arabia Bet Reveals About the Gulf’s Divided Recovery
items.summary: Radisson’s own development numbers are the latest confirmation of a pattern playing out across the Gulf: domestic demand is the hedge, and Saudi Arabia has it, the UAE doesn’t.

items.title: Thailand’s Six-Year Tourist Fee Saga Returns With a $14 Price Tag
items.summary: After five policy reversals and one outright cancellation, Thailand's six-year-old-tourism fee plan is back at THB 450 — pending, naturally, another round of approvals.

items.title: In Praise of Kayak, 21 Years Later

items.title: The New Long-Haul Routes Testing How Far Demand Really Stretches
items.summary: From Sapporo to Riyadh, airlines are getting bolder with their long-haul route bets and using efficient widebody jets to test markets that may once have seemed too niche.

items.title: Viator’s Updated Operator Agreement Formalizes a Power Shift in Experiences Pricing: Scoop
items.summary: Is Airbnb's partnership with Tripadvisor merely an expansion of Airbnb's partnership with Tripadvisor's res-tech unit Bokun? So far some Airbnb employees aren't seeing signs of a broad, new Viator inventory partnership in the works.

items.title: The Iran War Shows How Reliant Indian Airlines Are on Gulf Hubs
